Both plots share the same time window. Switch between “Play mix” and “Hear lowest tone” to compare their timbre.

Try 100, 200, 300 Hz: the added harmonics change the shape and tone color. Try 100 and 102 Hz, then select 5 sec to see and hear the slow beating.
Signal: Σ amplitude × sin(2π × frequency × time). Audio is scaled by the sum of active amplitudes to prevent clipping; plots show the original relative amplitudes. At wide time scales, dense waves appear as envelopes.
